description: Merge a branch/changeset/label into the current workspace branch. Refused while tracked pending changes exist or when the merge has conflicts (resolve those in the UVCS client); the merge result stays pending until a checkin. Requires prepare/confirm. Returns a short-lived confirmation token.

comment.description: Optional merge comment; Plastic may still require a follow-up checkin.

source.description: Merge source spec, for example /main/task, cs:94, or lb:LABEL.

name: uvcs_merge_prepare
